name: AdvancedEAPanelDemo
summary: This EA is a demo for the AdvancedEAPanel library, providing a graphical control panel on the chart with tabbed navigation and side buttons. It handles chart events for button clicks, object dragging, and edit fields, delegating logic to the CAdvancedEAPanel class. The panel itself does not implement any autonomous trading strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA是AdvancedEAPanel库的演示程序，在图表上创建一个带标签页导航和侧边按钮的图形控制面板。它处理按钮点击、对象拖拽和编辑框等图表事件，将逻辑委托给CAdvancedEAPanel类。该面板本身不实现任何自主交易策略。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非自主交易策略，而是一个交互式交易面板工具。它通过CAdvancedEAPanel类创建包含标签页和侧边按钮的GUI界面，允许用户在图表上手动操作交易相关功能。入场和出场条件完全取决于用户与面板的交互，而非程序自动生成的信号。仓位管理和资金管理同样依赖用户手动输入，面板仅提供界面支持。面板支持标签页切换（至少两个标签页tab0和tab1）、侧边按钮操作（含展开/隐藏功能）、对象拖拽处理（如建议入场线的拖拽）以及编辑框输入处理。整体而言，这是一个半自动化交易辅助工具，不具备自动开仓能力。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an autonomous trading strategy but an interactive trading panel utility. It creates a GUI with tabs and side buttons via the CAdvancedEAPanel class, allowing users to manually operate trading-related functions on the chart. Entry and exit conditions depend entirely on user interaction with the panel rather than programmatically generated signals. Position sizing and money management also rely on manual user input, with the panel providing only the interface. The panel supports tab switching (at least two tabs: tab0 and tab1), side button operations (including expand/hide functionality), object drag handling (such as dragging a suggested entry line), and edit field input processing. Overall, this is a semi-automated trading assistance tool without autonomous position-opening capability.

parameters.name: panel.Color
parameters.description: 面板及标签页背景颜色

pros: 提供直观的图形化交易面板，改善用户交互体验
采用标签页和侧边按钮的模块化UI设计，功能分区清晰
支持对象拖拽和编辑框事件，具备灵活的手动操作能力
pros_en: Provides an intuitive graphical trading panel that improves user interaction experience
Modular UI design with tabs and side buttons enables clear functional separation
Supports object dragging and edit field events, offering flexible manual operation capabilities
cons: 仅是演示程序，缺少实际交易逻辑实现
OnDeinit函数为空，未做资源清理和面板销毁操作
依赖外部AdvancedEAPanel.mqh库，核心功能不透明且无法独立评估
cons_en: Only a demo program lacking actual trading logic implementation
OnDeinit function is empty, with no resource cleanup or panel destruction
Depends on the external AdvancedEAPanel.mqh library, making core functionality opaque and independently unevaluable
improvements: 在OnDeinit中添加面板销毁和图形对象清理逻辑，防止切换时间帧时残留对象
增加输入参数外部化（如面板尺寸、颜色、按钮数量），提升可配置性
improvements_en: Add panel destruction and graphical object cleanup logic in OnDeinit to prevent leftover objects on timeframe changes
Externalize input parameters (panel size, color, button count) for improved configurability

risk_points: OnDeinit未清理图形对象，切换时间帧或移除EA时可能留下残留面板元素
缺少输入参数验证，异常参数可能导致面板渲染异常
risk_points_en: OnDeinit does not clean up graphical objects, potentially leaving residual panel elements when switching timeframes or removing the EA
Lack of input parameter validation may cause panel rendering issues with abnormal values
